excerpt: The NA62 experiment has measured the branching ratio of the rare decay K+ -> pi+ nu nubar using data collected in 2023 and 2024 at the CERN SPS, obtaining B_2023-2024 = (7.2+2.3-2.1) x 10^-11. With results from data collected between 2016 and 2022, the analysis gives B_2016-2024 = (9.6+1.9-1.8) x 10^-11, corresponding to a relative precision of 20%.
title: Measurement of the branching ratio of the K+ -> pi+ nu nubar decay
